title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the equilibrium temperature T_e.

title: Heat Balance Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the equation relating the heat output of the pump and the heat loss from the building.

title: Efficiency Definition
description: Important Criteria: The student must define the efficiency of the heat pump correctly as eta = 1 - T_0 / T_e.

title: Correct Algebra
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly manipulate the equations to isolate T_e.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms in the equations are consistent in terms of units.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes when setting up the heat balance equation.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss the behavior of T_e in limiting cases, such as when W is very large or very small.
